notes_for_editor: Two text sources agree on 1934 and a 100-foot steel stairway tower. The A-Z table height column reads 86, which is not explained. The A-Z entry's 1959 survey notes (120 and 125 feet) appear to belong to the neighbouring Savage entry, so they are not used. No staffing, fire history or current access statement was found. The 2019 significance study is named but its report was not located. An AllTrails trail page (saying the tower is closed to the public) returned 403 and was not used. The brief's record values (agency, height 30.5, standing) are consistent with the sources.
